cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：挣扎；奋斗
cards.example_en: Some students struggle with long division at first.
cards.example_zh: 有些学生一开始做长除法时很吃力。

cards.example_en: The hotel suite had a sofa and two single beds.
cards.example_zh: 这家旅馆的套间里有一张沙发和两张单人床。

cards.example_en: We swim in the indoor pool on cold winter days.
cards.example_zh: 寒冷的冬日里，我们在室内泳池游泳。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：队；团队
cards.example_en: The relay team dropped the baton on the last bend.
cards.example_zh: 接力队在最后一个弯道掉了接力棒。

cards.example_en: Rain cancelled tennis, so we played cards indoors.
cards.example_zh: 下雨取消了网球，我们就改在室内打牌。

cards.example_en: A worrying thought kept me awake past midnight.
cards.example_zh: 一个令人不安的想法让我过了午夜还睡不着。

cards.example_en: Don't throw paper onto the grass beside the court.
cards.example_zh: 不要把纸扔到球场旁边的草地上。

cards.example_en: These football shoes feel tight around my toes.
cards.example_zh: 这双足球鞋把我的脚趾夹得很紧。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：疲倦的
cards.example_en: Dad came home tired after the night shift.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸上完夜班，回到家时已经很累了。

cards.example_en: The puppy chewed the rubber toy until it split.
cards.example_zh: 小狗把那个橡胶玩具啃到裂开了。

cards.example_en: Police can trace the lost bag through the cameras.
cards.example_zh: 警方可以通过摄像头追踪丢失的包。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：运动鞋
cards.example_en: Clean your trainers before you walk on the carpet.
cards.example_zh: 走上地毯之前，先把运动鞋擦干净。

cards.example_en: Our relay team can win if the last runner starts well.
cards.example_zh: 如果最后一棒起跑顺利，我们的接力队就能赢。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：暗示；含义
cards.example_en: His silence had the implication that the plan had failed.
cards.example_zh: 他的沉默暗示这个计划已经失败了。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：代表；表现
cards.example_en: The drawing is a representation of our old school gate.
cards.example_zh: 这幅画是我们旧校门的一种表现。
